name: Most Probable Paths (MPP) Lighting Model
aliases: Most Probable Path (MPP) Multiple Scattering Model
definition: A lighting model for general participating media that splits radiance into object, single-scattered, and multiple-scattered components, using Most Probable Paths (MPPs) to approximate scattering integrals.
summary: The Most Probable Paths lighting model approximates multiple scattering in inhomogeneous media by summing contributions from paths near the most probable path, avoiding diffusion artifacts.
